title: The Last Tide Again
author: S. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Beatrix Coldharbour, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
